name: Weekly newsletter keeper
why: Turns weekly notes into a newsletter issue checked for voice before it goes out, a good fit for the staff newsletter skill.

name: Plain English editor
why: Rewrites stiff leadership drafts in plain words with each cut explained.

name: Announce a change of direction and keep the team
why: A step-by-step plan for announcing a new direction to staff, alongside the change announcement skill.

name: Make a new policy understandable to staff
why: Turns a new policy into plain staff messages and intranet copy; check this with local rules or HR before it goes out.

name: Review staff adoption of a policy change
why: Checks whether staff have taken up a change after the announcement, the follow-up step after a pulse check.

name: Turn employee feedback into owned actions
why: Turns pulse check and town hall feedback into actions with owners for the you-said-we-did reply.

name: Top-priority shift memo writer
why: Writes a one-page memo resetting the team's top priority, a useful base for a leadership update.

name: Team culture memo writer
why: Drafts a one-page culture memo leaders can share and explain at a town hall.

name: Hardest objections answer writer
why: Finds the toughest questions staff may ask and writes fair answers, for town hall preparation.

name: Plan staff coverage during a disruption
why: Plans staff coverage before a disruption is announced, so the message can say who covers what.

name: Layoff plan writer
why: Drafts a layoff plan with a manager script and company message; the legal wording and process always go to HR or a legal adviser, and need a check with local rules.
